title: CodexTrust
description: The trust in Codex of the worktrees of a command that adds worktrees to a pool, with Codex connected.

trusted.description: The worktrees of the command whose trust in Codex the command wrote, by the record of the root of their main repository; in no order.

distrusted.description: The worktrees of the command whose record of trust in Codex the operator set other than trusted: they are left as they are; in no order.

error.description: Present if the settings of Codex could not be used: unreadable or unwritable; then they are left as they are. The list is open: a client shows an unknown value as is.
